about.title: About
about.headline: I edit for the feeling, not just the frame.
about.bio1: I'm Supun Gunarathna — a video editor and colorist based in Sri Lanka. My primary tools are DaVinci Resolve and Premiere Pro. I've been the editorial lead for production work at UVOCTECH, covering ceremonies, batch trips, and institutional media.
about.bio2: Alongside post-production, I'm studying BSc Multimedia and Web Technology at the University of Vocational Technology, which is where my interest in web, mobile, and AI-assisted workflows comes from. Both sides of the craft inform each other.
about.info_university: University of Vocational Technology, Sri Lanka
